title: OpenHarmony Bench: Evaluating LLMs and Coding Agents on OpenHarmony App Development
abstract: arXiv:2608.16022v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present OPENHARMONY BENCH, an app-level coding benchmark for evaluating LLM-based coding agents on OpenHarmony ArkTS applications. Unlike function-level benchmarks, it evaluates complete app-level changes: each task requires an agent to modify a buildable ArkTS project so that a requested behavior works end to end, involving UI state, data persistence, build configuration, and platform APIs. The benchmark installs and drives the delivered application on a device to check whether the behavior is observable. It covers three input sources: natural-language feature requests (new-feature), structured scenario specifications (spec-driven), and bug descriptions (bug-fix). The benchmark contains 153 top-level tasks and 242 Feature points (F-points), where an F-point is one executable behavior check. The snapshot includes 32 new-feature tasks, 50 spec-driven tasks with 139 F-points, and 71 bug-fix tasks. The main leaderboard is scored over top

translated_title: OpenHarmony Bench：评估LLM与编码代理在OpenHarmony应用开发中的表现
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16022v1 公告类型：新发布 摘要：我们提出了OPENHARMONY BENCH，一个应用级别的编码基准，用于评估基于LLM的编码代理在OpenHarmony ArkTS应用上的表现。与函数级基准不同，它评估完整的应用级修改：每个任务要求代理修改一个可构建的ArkTS项目，使所请求的行为端到端地工作，涉及UI状态、数据持久化、构建配置和平台API。该基准在设备上安装并驱动交付的应用，以检查行为是否可观察。它涵盖三种输入来源：自然语言功能请求（新功能）、结构化场景规范（规范驱动）和错误描述（错误修复）。该基准包含153个顶级任务和242个功能点（F-points），其中F-point是一个可执行的行为检查。快照包括32个新功能任务、50个规范驱动任务（含139个F-points）和71个错误修复任务。主排行榜基于顶级任务评分。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个应用级编码基准OpenHarmony Bench，用于全面评估LLM编码代理在OpenHarmony ArkTS应用开发中的端到端行为实现能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces OpenHarmony Bench, an app-level coding benchmark for evaluating LLM-based coding agents on end-to-end behavior implementation in OpenHarmony ArkTS app development.
